violated_contract: Test import isolation must not evict a native module whose state outlives its module object. CPython 3.11's _zoneinfo frees its globals in m_free while the static ZoneInfo type stays live, so an evicted copy collected after a re-import breaks ZoneInfo with 'SystemError: null argument to internal routine', at a time set by GC rather than by the test.
canonical_prevention: stub_modules keeps the real stdlib zoneinfo family (matched by object identity, never by name) once a block first imports it, as it already keeps the google and jiter native families. Add any further native family explicitly to the same preservation step.
